notes.text:
This update for dpdk fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-86561: missing memory size validation before mmap in vhost memory region setup (bsc#1285678).
- CVE-2026-86563: double offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation (bsc#1285676).
- CVE-2026-86565: split-ring inflight descriptor table overflow (bsc#1285672).
- CVE-2026-86566: copy length underflow in vhost enqueue (bsc#1285671).
- CVE-2026-86845: use-after-free and type confusion in vhost-crypto session handling (bsc#1285666).
- CVE-2026-86846: vhost-crypto TOCTOU out-of-bounds write in finalize path (bsc#1285664).
- CVE-2026-86847: infinite cleanup loop in vhost-crypto writeback chain (bsc#1285663).
- CVE-2026-86848: vhost-crypto TOCTOU out-of-bounds write in finalize path (bsc#1285657).
- CVE-2026-86849: integer overflow and missing validation in vhost-crypto request handling (bsc#1285658).
- CVE-2026-86856: stack and heap buffer overflow in nfp vDPA driver (bsc#1285659).
- CVE-2026-93683: indirect descriptor table double-fetch (bsc#1285660).
- CVE-2026-100236: GSO library heap out-of-bounds read/write with small mbuf pools (bsc#1285679).

notes.text: A flaw was found in the DPDK GSO library. When software GSO copies packet headers into a new mbuf, it does not check that the header fits in the source first segment or in the destination buffer, and a header longer than the configured GSO segment size can underflow the payload-size calculation. A remote or guest-supplied packet processed with software GSO can trigger an out-of-bounds read or write.

notes.text: A flaw was found in the DPDK vhost library. When handling a virtio indirect descriptor table, the host reads the table length more than once from guest memory and can allocate a host copy before validating that length. A guest that changes the length between those reads, or that supplies an out-of-range next index on a small host copy in the vDPA relay path, can cause the host vhost process to walk past the validated mapping or heap copy. That can crash or disrupt the vhost process. Out-of-bounds bytes are consumed as descriptor fields for GPA translation and are not returned to the guest as payload. This is a residual issue in the non-contiguous indirect descriptor copy path introduced as part of the CVE-2018-1059 fix.
